title: Design System: Dr. Robert Kübler · Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero h1 only — the name. Never reused at smaller sizes.

title.purpose: Card headings, featured article titles, project names.

lead.purpose: First About paragraph. Featured prose. One instance per section at most.

body.purpose: All prose — paragraphs, timeline bullets, contact text. Max 65ch.

label.purpose: Dates, stats, eyebrows, badges, all-caps markers. JetBrains Mono only.

motion.name: fade-up
motion.purpose: Hero entrance and scroll-reveal. Applied via .scroll-animate class.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Nav link color, focus ring appearance.

motion.name: state-default
motion.purpose: Button backgrounds, card border-color, card background fill.

motion.name: ease-out-std
motion.purpose: All state transitions. Ease-out only — no bounce, no elastic.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.note: Featured grids collapse to 1-column; avatar shrinks; mobile nav drawer

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.note: Nav collapses to hamburger below this width

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The CTA. The only filled element on any surface. Used for Contact and primary portfolio actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 24px; border: 1px solid #8a6820; background: #8a6820; color: #f4f1ea; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #755518; border-color: #755518; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8a6820; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions — social links, view-on-GitHub, publication links. Never competes with the CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 24px; border: 1px solid #e3ddd0; background: #faf8f4; color: #57516a; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, background 0.2s; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #8a6820; color: #1c1825; background: rgba(138,104,32,0.09); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8a6820; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tag Pill
components.description: Skill tags, technology labels, publication type indicators.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 24px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e3ddd0; color: #57516a; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Mono Label
components.description: Section eyebrow, date stamp, stat label, badge. JetBrains Mono, uppercase, xs size.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #57516a; }

components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { background: #faf8f4; border: 1px solid #e3ddd0; border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(28,24,37,0.07), 0 0 0 1px #e3ddd0; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #8a6820; background: #f0ece3; } .ds-card-eyebrow { display: block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.10em; color: #57516a; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; color: #1c1825; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #57516a; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Featured Card

components.css: .ds-timeline-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px 1fr; gap: 24px; padding: 24px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3ddd0; } .ds-timeline-period { display: block; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #57516a; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-timeline-company { display: block; font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #57516a; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-timeline-role { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1c1825; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-timeline-bullets { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-width: 65ch; } .ds-timeline-bullets li { font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #57516a; padding-left: 16px; position: relative; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-timeline-bullets li::before { content: '–'; position: absolute; left: 0; color: #8a6820; } .ds-timeline-bullets strong { color: #1c1825; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
This system makes its case without raising its voice. The palette is warm parchment and bronze ochre — the colors of a well-thumbed academic monograph, not a startup homepage. Typography does the heavy lifting: Bricolage Grotesque carries section headers with the confidence of a senior practitioner who doesn't pad his CV, while Source Serif 4 carries body copy with the measured weight of someone who has actually read what he cites. JetBrains Mono marks precise data points in a way that signals mathematical fluency without wearing it as a costume.

The system rejects noise by design. Sections alternate between off-white and cream, creating depth through tonal shift rather than shadow. Cards are slight elevations of the surface, anchored by a 1px border and a near-imperceptible ambient shadow. The single bronze-gold accent appears sparingly: a surname initial in the nav, a section label, a CTA. Its rarity is the point.
keyCharacteristics: Warm light theme — parchment base, not sterile white
Bronze-gold as a single, disciplined accent signal
Three fonts with non-overlapping roles, never blended
Editorial precision: every element placed with reason, none for decoration

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Scholar's Gold appears on fewer than 10% of any given screen's surface area. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Tonal Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Sections alternate between Parchment Cream and Paper White. Never two cream or two white sections back to back.

rules.name: The Trilingual Rule
rules.body: Bricolage commands. Source Serif 4 explains. JetBrains Mono measures. Never cross the domains.

rules.name: The Four-Level Rule
rules.body: Any screen uses at most four distinct visual text levels. Collapsing is always preferred over introducing a fifth.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are differentiated by background tint, not by drop shadow. Shadows anchor; they do not elevate.

rules.name: The No-Deep-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No shadow darker than rgba(28,24,37,0.10). If visible at arm's length without squinting, it is too dark.

dos: Do use Scholar's Gold on fewer than 10% of any screen's surface area.
Do alternate section backgrounds — Parchment Cream then Paper White — never two of the same in sequence.
Do use JetBrains Mono for every date, stat, metric, label, and badge.
Do set body text at max-width 65ch.
Do use the 1px Warm Grain border to define card identity.
Do keep all interactive elements at min-height 44px.
Do use prefers-reduced-motion to disable animations.
donts: Don't use a gradient hero, big-number stat block, or SaaS features grid.
Don't add skills progress bars or 'technologies I know' icon walls.
Don't use corporate consultant aesthetics: navy + gold, heavy serif headings, stiff formal grid.
Don't use cursor effects, WebGL/canvas backgrounds, or scroll-driven 3D.
Don't bury content behind visual decoration.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards.
Don't apply background-clip: text with a gradient.
Don't use rgba or hardcoded hex values when a CSS variable exists.
